packageRules.description: ort's release candidates break their API, and parakeet-rs builds against one of them: a bump waits for a person and CI, never automerges.

Runner images are pinned on purpose: ubuntu-22.04 sets the release binaries' glibc floor and carries a GCC that CUDA 12.9's nvcc accepts; ubuntu-24.04-arm builds the sd-cli prebuilt. See docs/operations/release.md.
